summary_1line: Draupadi urges Krishna toward vengeance for her humiliation, while Krishna prepares to depart as envoy to the Kauravas seeking peace.

image_candidates.scene_text: Draupadi, weeping, lifts her long dark braid in her hand and reminds Krishna of how Dussasana once dragged her by that hair before the assembly.
Krishna stands beside his radiant chariot as Garuda settles upon its flagstaff while sages, kings, and auspicious birds gather around him.
Krishna’s magnificent chariot with four named white horses rolls forward at dawn while the Pandavas and allied kings follow him in reverence.
